summary: Monitors another DAT, usually a table, and runs Python callbacks when its contents change, with 2025.30000+ onTableChange support for row, column, cell, and size diffs.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable or disable monitoring and callback execution

key_params.name: dat
key_params.note: The DAT whose contents are monitored for changes

key_params.name: tablechange
key_params.note: Calls onTableChange when any table content or size change is detected

key_params.name: rowchange
key_params.note: Legacy row-change callback toggle; deprecated in favor of onTableChange

key_params.name: colchange
key_params.note: Legacy column-change callback toggle; deprecated in favor of onTableChange

key_params.name: cellchange
key_params.note: Legacy cell-change callback toggle; deprecated in favor of onTableChange

key_params.name: sizechange
key_params.note: Legacy size-change callback toggle; deprecated in favor of onTableChange

key_params.name: execute
key_params.note: Run callbacks at the start of frame or coalesce them to the end of frame

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose the operator context used when executing callback code

common_gotchas: DAT Execute DAT is an active operator; DocsBrain can misclassify it as deprecated because the legacy row/column/cell/size callbacks are deprecated.
For 2025.30000 and later builds, prefer onTableChange(dat, prevDAT, info) and inspect the info lists for rows, columns, cells, and size changes.
DAT Execute DATs loaded from older builds may keep old callback comments, so create a fresh DAT Execute DAT or update comments before relying on generated templates.
Start-of-frame execution can run multiple times if a watched DAT changes repeatedly in one frame; end-of-frame execution coalesces repeated changes.
Sync to File can create or overwrite script files, so automation should avoid enabling it unless explicitly requested.
Use OP Execute DAT for operator state changes and Execute DAT for project/timeline events; DAT Execute DAT is specifically for DAT content changes.
build_relevance: 2025.30000+ DAT table-change callbacks and legacy callback deprecation
key_concepts: Monitors another DAT and runs callbacks when table contents or size change.
The current onTableChange callback reports row, column, cell, and size information through the info argument.
Legacy row, column, cell, and size callbacks remain represented as toggles for older callback templates.
Execute timing controls whether callbacks happen at the start or end of the frame.
